149ce313-0582-400d-a42d-1842e56bca78.new_description: A boutique winery focused on expressing the purity of the fruit. They emphasize sustainable farming and minimal intervention to highlight regional terroir and elegance. Fresh red cherry and raspberry notes dominate the start. Subtle hints of vanilla and forest floor emerge on the finish. Light to medium body with bright acidity and silky tannins. Red berry flavors lead to a clean, medium-length finish.
